session: lever 12 (fork N), 7 October 2026, at the user's word: 'start Paris-only network bet'
purpose: Design batch: does an LFPG-specialised context network (the shipped own_all recipe fitted on LFPG rows only) improve the shipped own-points member own_all on LFPG rows? LFPG carries the largest projected ranking error pot (rows never seen on the ground: 6.4e9 s2 of the projected ranking squared error, docs/hunt/README.md); 79% of its ranking rows have no ADS-B match.
prior: Low. docs/adsb_unm/README.md (28 September): tree specialists fitted only on unmatched rows or with unmatched rows up-weighted read within +-0.04% of their all-row controls (no GO): the committee's all-row members already spend their capacity where the unmatched rows need it. docs/hunt/README.md (7 October): every LFPG gap is receiver coverage, not a matching key; no new observation exists. No airport-specialist context network has been fitted before (the LIRF networks exist because the global networks exclude LIRF, not as specialists).
exploration_disclosed: Known before this declaration: docs/hunt/pools.csv (2025 development squared error by airport and observation class against the v68 development proxy: LFPG unm_unseen 1.35e10 s2 on 59,062 2025 rows, RMSE 477.6 s); label-free LFPG ADS-B match shares by month (matches2 tables over raw LFPG departures): 2025-07 7.2%, 2025-10 19.5% (gate 0.3%), 2025-11 36.5%, 2025-12 24.1%, 2026-01 20.6% (gate 0.2%), 2026-07 21.1% (gate 0.3%). No network was fitted on LFPG rows alone and no October reading of such a network exists.
coverage_note: October 2025 LFPG coverage (matched 19.5%, gate 0.3%) equals the ranking months' (20.6% / 21.1%, gate 0.2% / 0.3%), so the complete October reading is already a reading at 2026 LFPG coverage: no separate thinned October reading is made (the thinned sets of docs/coverage_regime/ do not thin LFPG). The shipped masking (m25 on the unmatched-row network) is kept; no LFPG-specific masking.
hardware: AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each), on-demand or spot, us-east-2 / us-east-1 / us-west-2 via SkyPilot from WSL, clusters prc-ctx6a-l only (infra/aws/sky_ctx6_*.yaml; infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20261007b.json). tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design --device cuda --threads 3, two lanes per GPU, unchanged runner and model code.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design, unchanged: the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09); the LFPG variants keep only LFPG rows for fitting and monitoring (rows.exclude_airports = the nine other airports); October predictions of every October row are written, only LFPG rows are read for the candidates
protocol.inputs: --extra-features data/external/adsblol/features_v19own (the shipped own-points tables, hash-checked against docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints_features_manifest.json)

variants.lfpg_own: lfpg_dl32own (matched-row network) + lfpg_m25dl32own (unmatched-row network): the own_all recipe (dl32own / m25dl32own settings unchanged) fitted on LFPG rows only
variants.lfpg_b512: lfpg_dl32own_b512 + lfpg_m25dl32own_b512: the same rows with batch 512 (about four times the optimiser steps of the LFPG-only fit at batch 2048), lr 0.001, dropout 0.2 (more regularisation for about one ninth of the data)

protocol.control: C = own_all as shipped: dl32own seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, m25dl32own seed mean on the others, from lever 5's GPU design fits (runs/ctx_own2/design/<variant>_s<seed>/design, seeds 9-16, L40S, configs/ctx_own2_design_v1.json, same code); reused, not refitted. The report checks each control run's variant_sha256 against this file's dl32own / m25dl32own (identical settings) and that it ran on cuda.
protocol.items: for each variant V in {lfpg_own, lfpg_b512} and c in {0.5, 1.0}: X = C on every non-LFPG row; on LFPG rows X = (1 - c) C + c S_V, S_V = V's matched-row network seed mean on matched rows and V's unmatched-row network seed mean on the others. Four decision items: lfpg_own_c50, lfpg_own_c100, lfpg_b512_c50, lfpg_b512_c100.

readings.R1: October LFPG RMSE of each item (8-seed means), LFPG matched / unmatched; October non-LIRF RMSE
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all October rows) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 [(1 - b) P + b X], P = tunnel 21's pool (0.5 ctx seeds 101-116 + 0.5 ctx_e24 seeds 117-132), b in {0.4, 0.5, 1.0}; share 0.85 reported beside it. b = 1.0 is v66 / v69's member weight.
readings.interval: paired-day 95% interval (tools/nn_design_report.day_interval) of the proxy difference against the control at b = 1.0

protocol.decision: An item is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 1.0 is at least 0.05 points below the control's (lever 9 / lever 5 / tunnel 21's bar), (b) its 8-seed October LFPG RMSE is below the control's, and (c) the paired-day 95% interval of the proxy difference at b = 1.0 lies below zero. Several GO items: the one with the lowest R2 at b = 1.0. A development round (16 seeds x the 2025 LOMO folds, stage 2 in v69's pinned chain) is declared separately only after a GO and only with the coordinator's word.
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or of the ranking months. No official score or leaderboard enters.
